# Erdos.p274 — Erdős problem 274

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/274
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/274.lean`, theorem `herzog_schonheim`, AMS 20).

Let $G$ be a group, and let $A = \{a_1G_1, \dots, a_kG_k\}$ be a finite system of left cosets of
subgroups $G_1, \dots, G_k$ of $G$.

Herzog and Schönheim conjectured that if $A$ forms a partition of $G$ with $k > 1$, then the
indices $[G:G_1], \dots, [G:G_k]$ cannot be distinct.

## Statement
∀ {G : Type*} [Group G] (hG : 1 < ENat.card G) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (hι : 1 < Fintype.card ι) (P : Group.ExactCovering G ι), ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ (P.parts i).index = (P.parts j).index

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
